defaults.outcomeText: Interview notes gathered. Later negotiation or intimidation takes 1 simulated minute instead of 3. Required Profession tiers still apply.
Negotiated surrender. Surrendered people are no longer active threats; restraint is a separate action.
The demand for surrender was accepted. No negotiated terms or faction agreement were created.
